plan.notes: Parsed 2026-10-02 from the official Sacramento State 2026-2027 Catalog 'BA in Theatre' page 4-Year Roadmap Plan of Study Grid. Semester unit totals verified against the catalog's printed semester totals and the printed Total Units figure. GE-area and 'Elective of Choice' placeholder rows are seeded as choice slots (any course fulfilling the area). Catalog 'A or B' rows are seeded as choice slots with the first-listed code. The catalog grid publishes no prerequisite column; prereq arrays are empty. A separate 2-Year Roadmap for transfer students is also published on the page and is not seeded. Note: the following course(s) are printed by the catalog in multiple semesters and kept verbatim as published (repeated enrollment; semester totals reconcile): THEA 120A. REPEATED-ENROLLMENT COURSES (coordinator-verified verbatim from the official published roadmap; allow_repeated_courses set): THEA 120A Practicum in Technical Production (sems 2,5,6).
